detect_nan_inf_forward: detect NaN or Inf values in the forward pass of a PyTorch model using NanDetector
detect_nan_inf_backward: detect NaN or Inf values in the backward pass of a PyTorch model using NanDetector
use_context_manager: use NanDetector as a context manager to automatically detect and log NaN/Inf during training
reset_detector: reset the NanDetector flags to allow re-detection of NaN/Inf in subsequent passes
inspect_gradient_norms: inspect and log gradient norms for all model parameters when NaN/Inf is detected
